summary.text: Michelle Davis is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives, District 58, since November 2020, who is not seeking re-election to that seat and is the Republican candidate for Indiana State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Davis earned a B.S. in elementary education from Ball State University and an M.Ed. in curriculum and instruction from Purdue University.
Her career experience includes working as director of adult education at Central Nine Career Center and owning a business.
Davis assumed office in the Indiana House on November 4, 2020, succeeding Charles Burton.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development, Education (vice chair), and House Judiciary committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 41 on May 5, 2026.
